newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-National league of Ireland premier fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-National league of Ireland premier fixtures.

text.p: This weekend's national league of Ireland premier division fixtures are as follows. Kick-off times are given in GMT:
Shelbourne versus Finn Harp at Tolka Park, 1845.
St.Patrick's Athletic versus Cork City at Richmond Park, 1845.
Dundalk versus Shamrock Rovers at Oriel Park, 1845.
Home Farm versus Bohemians at Whitehall, 1830
Derry City versus Sligo Rovers at Brandywell, 1830
Bray Wanderers versus University College Dublin at Carlisle Ground, 1415.
